# Upstream commits this downstream repository has consciously decided never to port.
# tools/upstream_triage.py skips anything listed here so it stops re-surfacing
# in the weekly Upstream watch report. One SHA per line (short or full); text
# after # is a note.
#
# Only for commits reviewed and rejected on purpose. Commits we DO port drop off
# automatically once cherry-picked (patch-id match), so they never need an entry.
# Likewise commits that only touch files this repo removed are auto-skipped.
